Wedding Photography in
Budapest & Across Hungary

Natural, elegant wedding photos—from getting ready to the last dance

We photograph weddings with a balance of honest documentary moments and refined editorial portraits. Based in Budapest and available throughout Hungary, we preserve the atmosphere, emotions and details that make your celebration uniquely yours.

Flexible coverage for intimate ceremonies, full wedding days and celebrations across Hungary.

Meet Your Wedding Photographers

Two distinct personalities. Two different perspectives. One shared vision.

We notice different details and respond to different moments. Working together allows us to tell a richer, more complete story of your wedding—while giving you the freedom to experience the day naturally.

Alexandra Kulcsár-Horváth

Wedding, portrait and lifestyle photographer

Alexandra brings a sensitive, intuitive approach to wedding photography, focusing on natural expressions, personal connections and the quiet moments that can easily pass unnoticed.

Dániel Z. Aczél

Photographer and founder of Aether Art Space

Dániel combines precise composition and creative lighting with an editorial perspective. Working in both digital and analogue photography, he brings a distinctive visual character to each wedding story.

Together, we balance careful direction with unobtrusive observation—stepping in when guidance is helpful and disappearing into the background when the moment should simply unfold.

Wedding Photography FAQ

Do you photograph weddings outside Budapest?

Yes. We are based in Budapest and available for weddings throughout Hungary. Tell us your venue when requesting an offer so we can include any travel requirements in your quote.

Are two photographers included?

Yes. Our wedding photography packages include two photographers. This allows important moments, reactions and details to be documented from different perspectives throughout your coverage.

Can we customise a wedding photography package?

Yes. The listed packages are starting points. After learning about your schedule, venue and priorities, we can tailor the coverage and optional services to your wedding.

Which parts of the wedding can you photograph?

Depending on your chosen package, coverage can include preparations, the ceremony, family and group portraits, creative couple portraits, the reception, dinner and the party.

Do you offer analogue wedding photography?

Yes. We can photograph selected moments on 35mm film alongside your digital wedding coverage. Analogue photography adds natural grain, rich tones and a nostalgic, beautifully imperfect character to your final collection.

Can we book a creative couple photoshoot separately?

Yes. Creative couple portraits can be photographed during the wedding day or arranged as a separate pre-wedding or post-wedding session. We will help you choose the best option for your schedule and preferred setting.

Do you offer bridal boudoir photography?

Yes. A bridal boudoir session can be added to your wedding photography package. It can take place during the preparations or as a separate, private studio session at Aether Art Space in Budapest.

What is your photography style?

Our approach combines natural documentary photography with elegant, carefully composed portraits. We capture genuine moments as they unfold and provide relaxed direction when it helps create a stronger photograph.

How do we choose the right package?

Send us your wedding date, venue and approximate schedule, together with the moments you would most like photographed. We will recommend the most suitable package and prepare a tailored offer.

How do we reserve our wedding date?

Contact us to check availability and discuss your plans. Once the details and tailored offer are agreed, we will guide you through the steps required to confirm your booking.
